title: RequestRecord
description: One row of requests.parquet. Optional fields are absent (null in Parquet) when not measured.

scheduled_at.description: When the pacer scheduled the send. Absent (null in Parquet) when the engine records no schedule, as inference-perf 0.7.0 does.

send_lag_seconds.description: sent_at minus scheduled_at. Absent (null in Parquet) together with scheduled_at.

ttft_seconds.description: Time to first generated token of any kind (content, reasoning, tool calls, text).

first_content_seconds.description: Time to the first visible content token. Later than ttft_seconds when the model emits reasoning or tool-call tokens first. Absent when no content token arrived.

itl_seconds.description: Inter-token latencies; definitions are fixed in the normalize step.

request_bytes.description: Size of the request body sent, in bytes. Absent when the engine does not report it.

status.description: HTTP status, or 0 when no response arrived.

phase.description: warmup rows are kept in the raw data but excluded from stage statistics.

stage_index.description: Zero-based stage. Required when phase is stage; a warmup row may omit it.

worker.description: Worker or shard that sent the request.
